deployments_detail.use: AI-based motion-planning picking robots for warehouse/logistics automation: robots that autonomously handle the variety and complexity of apparel picking, deployed to automate Fast Retailing brand warehouses. [MUJIN (Motion Planning AI), Exotec Solutions, Daifuku]
AI demand forecasting + supply-chain optimization (with Google); customer-voice AI analysis (millions/year); "UNIQLO IQ" AI styling app

AI-driven demand forecasting under the Ariake Project: Fast Retailing works with Google Cloud's Advanced Solutions Lab to apply advanced machine learning to analyze customer data and forecast product demand, coordinating sales, production, and inventory planning. [Google Cloud (Advanced Solutions Lab)]
Image-recognition + machine learning to evaluate product/fashion trends, feeding design and merchandising decisions (part of the Ariake Project collaboration with Google Cloud). [Google Cloud]
StyleHint: an image-recognition-powered style search app that lets users upload/take photos of clothing and be matched with visually similar UNIQLO and GU products and styling inspiration. [none]

MySize ASSIST: an AI algorithm in the UNIQLO app that estimates a shopper's body shape and recommends a clothing size based on sex, age, height, weight and fit preference (with phone-camera body measurement). [none]

Google-powered personalization in the UNIQLO app: AI tailors product recommendations and rankings to individual users (by occasion, preferences, and behavior), part of UNIQLO IQ's digital shopping experience. [Google]

AI analysis of customer feedback: UNIQLO uses AI to analyze the ~30 million+ customer comments received annually, increasing accuracy and speed of feedback analysis and dissemination to inform product development and improvement. [none]
deployments_detail.value: over 30 million customer comments analyzed annually

deployments_detail.use: UNIQLO IQ virtual shopping assistant / chatbot: an AI-powered conversational assistant (voice + chat) built with Google technology that provides personalized product recommendations, sizing help, and order/return support. [Google Cloud (Google Assistant / ML); agencies Inamoto & Co, Party]

Machine-learning e-commerce search: Fast Retailing is leveraging/evaluating LLMs, vector search and semantic search (on top of Amazon OpenSearch) to reduce manual synonym/keyword registration and improve e-commerce site search relevance. [AWS (Amazon OpenSearch Service)]
